evals.prompt: 帮我做一张公众号封面，主题是新模型发布，要高级感。先帮我把提示词想清楚，不要真的生成图片。
evals.expected_output: Turns the vague adjective into a specific Chinese T2I brief with a fitting named visual system or explicit visual grammar, medium, hierarchy, on-image text language, aspect/size status, default Modellix image slug, and a stop-after-prompt next step. It does not execute image generation.
assertions: Returned the final image prompt in Chinese
Replaced the vague request for a premium look with a specific named visual system or concrete visual grammar
Included on-image text language and aspect/size status in the handoff
Suggested google/nano-banana-2-lite without browsing the model catalog
Stopped after prompt preparation and did not invoke an image-generation command

evals.prompt: Make a 4x4 set of AI-tool icons. I only need the prompt and production brief for now, not the generated image.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the batch-grid method and returns an English T2I prompt for sixteen specified or sensibly enumerated icons, a square 4x4 semantic grid, consistent visual grammar, no visible grid helpers, and explicit post-processing caveats. It does not claim to crop or generate files.
assertions: Classified the task as T2I and a 4x4 grid
Specified sixteen icon subjects or requested the missing exact list
Requested consistent scale, viewpoint, visual system, and background
Prohibited visible grid lines, borders, labels, and cell numbers
Stated that cropping or transparency post-processing is a separate step
Did not invoke image generation or claim that output files were created

evals.prompt: Run this on the default image model: Dieter Rams style DJI Pocket 3 manual. The prompt is final; do not rewrite it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the prompt is already specific and final, avoids a heavy prompt-engineering pass, preserves it verbatim or performs only a one-line readiness check, then routes execution to modellix-design.
assertions: Did not expand or substantially rewrite the supplied final prompt
Recognized the named subject, visual system, and medium as sufficient
Did not duplicate credential, polling, schema, or download policy
